#!/bin/bash
set -e

cd /root/cert_manip_resist_eval
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
source /etc/network_turbo 2>/dev/null || true
export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt

LOG=/tmp/step1_autoscale.log
CHECKPOINT_DIR=artifacts/results/plan001/individual_scores

count_checkpoints() {
    ls $CHECKPOINT_DIR 2>/dev/null | wc -l
}

INITIAL_COUNT=$(count_checkpoints)
echo "[$(date)] Starting. Initial checkpoints: $INITIAL_COUNT" | tee -a $LOG

# === TIER 1: 1 worker, 1 RPS ===
echo "[$(date)] TIER 1: 1w/1r — waiting for 10 new checkpoints" | tee -a $LOG
python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 1 --max-rps 1.0 &
PID=$!

while true; do
    sleep 30
    CURRENT=$(count_checkpoints)
    NEW=$((CURRENT - INITIAL_COUNT))
    echo "[$(date)] Tier 1: $NEW new checkpoints (total: $CURRENT)" | tee -a $LOG
    
    if [ $NEW -ge 10 ]; then
        echo "[$(date)] Tier 1 passed! Upgrading to Tier 2" | tee -a $LOG
        kill $PID 2>/dev/null
        sleep 5
        break
    fi
    
    if ! kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[$(date)] Process died during Tier 1. Restarting at Tier 1." | tee -a $LOG
        python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 1 --max-rps 1.0 &
        PID=$!
    fi
done

# === TIER 2: 3 workers, 2 RPS ===
echo "[$(date)] TIER 2: 3w/2r — monitoring 5 minutes" | tee -a $LOG
TIER2_START=$(count_checkpoints)
python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 3 --max-rps 2.0 &
PID=$!

for i in $(seq 1 10); do
    sleep 30
    CURRENT=$(count_checkpoints)
    NEW=$((CURRENT - TIER2_START))
    echo "[$(date)] Tier 2 check $i/10: $NEW new checkpoints since tier start" | tee -a $LOG
    
    if ! kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[$(date)] Process died during Tier 2. Falling back to Tier 1." | tee -a $LOG
        python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 1 --max-rps 1.0 &
        PID=$!
        wait $PID
        exit 0
    fi
done

echo "[$(date)] Tier 2 stable! Upgrading to Tier 3" | tee -a $LOG
kill $PID 2>/dev/null
sleep 5

# === TIER 3: 5 workers, 3 RPS ===
echo "[$(date)] TIER 3: 5w/3r — final speed" | tee -a $LOG
python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 5 --max-rps 3.0 &
PID=$!

for i in $(seq 1 4); do
    sleep 30
    CURRENT=$(count_checkpoints)
    echo "[$(date)] Tier 3 check $i: total checkpoints: $CURRENT" | tee -a $LOG
    
    if ! kill -0 $PID 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[$(date)] Process died during Tier 3. Falling back to Tier 2." | tee -a $LOG
        python scripts/run_plan001_step1_batched.py --max-workers 3 --max-rps 2.0 &
        PID=$!
        break
    fi
done

echo "[$(date)] Auto-scale complete. Running at final tier." | tee -a $LOG
wait $PID
echo "[$(date)] Scoring finished. Final checkpoints: $(count_checkpoints)" | tee -a $LOG
